# P06 implementation progress

The approved P06 slice is implemented. The runtime in
`scripts/context_chronology_v1.py` provides explicit context compatibility and
mapping witnesses, finite partition enumeration, supersession-DAG evidence
selection, date-only availability policy, revision-compatible cumulative
subtraction, six uncertainty-category admission, information-view guards, and
query-signature-bound fixed-rate unhedged bullet-debt resolution with an optional
triangle-inequality approximation certificate.

Changed phase files are the versioned profile, fixture, runtime, focused tests,
checker, and the three declared P06 deliverables. Existing P03/P04 modules,
fixtures, benchmark releases, controller files, and preserved evidence were not
edited. Git provenance is unavailable in this workspace; the checker records
content hashes and supervisor inventory comparisons.

Checks completed:

- `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 python3 -B -m unittest tests/test_accounting_p06.py -v`: 18 passed.
- P03 regression: 11 passed.
- P04 regression: 21 passed.
- P06 checker with approved plan and execution inventory: 7/7 obligations observed once, zero failures/errors/skips, protected inputs unchanged, source/test hashes stable, exit 0.
- Failure-path probe with `--inject-failure`: `conformance.passed=false`, exit 1; a final normal checker run restored the passing artifact.

Remaining work is independent result review. This artifact establishes bounded
engineering behavior only. General measurement conversion, consolidation,
continuous/nonlinear uncertainty, historical byte-vintage truth, accounting and
forecast validity, human acceptance, and wider MC01–MC35/G1–G18 obligations
remain open.
